verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow orchestration platform, so a central, team-shared credential store with per-credential access control is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such capability. The closest items are Cloud control-plane management of Users, Service Accounts and API keys, and Payload Codecs for encrypting Workflow data. These are adjacent controls for accessing Temporal itself and protecting payloads, not a shared store for connection credentials with per-credential permissions.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can store connection credentials centrally, share them with my team, and control who can use which credential
